body.x: COBL will exhibit the Coding block COBL at CES 2019, the world's largest technology exhibition in Las Vegas, USA, from January 8 (Tue) to January 11 (Fri).

COBL stands for Coding Block and is auser-programmable block coding product. In addition, it is a comprehensiveeducational tool for learning software makers from the control of the mostbasic sensors and input / output devices, robotics, to IoT learning.
Coding Block COBL features various softwaresuch as scratch 2.0, app inventory, IOT, and can be freely assembled usingblocks.
